question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**every**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** In this context, "every" is the most suitable option as it implies the entirety of the votes.**
 
• **"Every" is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
 
 
• The word "every" means each and every one of a group or category.
 
• It is used to indicate a complete or total amount.
 
 
• Example: Every student in the class is required to participate in the contest.
 
 
 
 
 
• The other given words do not fit the context of the sentence.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "few", means a small number of something and is the opposite of "many".
 
• Option 3, "much", refers to a large quantity of something and is often used with uncountable nouns.
 
• Option 4, "all", means the whole of something and is often used to refer to a complete set or group.
